program_solutions:
(rule!
  ;; Objects whose color is blue(1)
  (let* ((comps (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0)))
         ;; Count of red(2) cells
         (k (length (find-color g 2)))
         ;; Count of green(3) cells
         (t (length (find-color g 3)))
         ;; Positions of every cyan(8) cell
         (targets (find-color g 8)))
    (define (rot90 cells)
      (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p)
                              (let ((h (+ 1 (apply max (map first cells)))))
                                (list (second p) (- h 1 (first p)))))
                            cells)))
    (define (rot180 cells) (rot90 (rot90 cells)))
    (define (flip-h cells)
      (let ((w (+ 1 (apply max (map second cells)))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- w 1 (second p)))) cells))))
    (if (and (not (empty? comps)) (not (empty? targets)) (>= k 1) (<= k (length comps)) (>= t 1) (<= t 4))
        ;; Position of the first cyan(8) cell
        (let* ((target (first targets))
               (obj (list-ref (sort comps (lambda (a b) (< (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))) (- k 1)))
               ;; Same shape, translated so its bbox starts at (0,0)
               (shape0 (normalize-cells (obj-cells obj)))
               (shape (cond [(= t 1) shape0] [(= t 2) (rot90 shape0)] [(= t 3) (rot180 shape0)] [else (flip-h shape0)]))
               (placed (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first target) (first p)) (+ (second target) (second p)))) shape)))
          (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) placed 7))
        (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0))))
